reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was 30 individual foil sachets, which is a lot of trash, and at about $1 a day it's 3 or 4 times what I pay per serving for bottled bisglycinate. The batch lab report QR is a nice touch, but I already fill my pill case myself and only travel every few weeks, so I don't need this every day.
objection: I'd pay triple per serving for packaging I only really need on trips, it creates foil waste, and there are no reviews yet for a brand I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A small trial pack of 7 to 10 sachets for around $9 to $12, or a bottle of the same tested capsules at a normal per-serving price, plus some real reviews.
